task.title: Extend closed Phase L with L8a, L8b and L9 (hardware-adaptive local AI, external models, time budgets and progress)
task.objective: Planning and registration only. Reopen the Phase L epic awkit-djnl for the owner's post-closeout scope expansion of 2026-09-27 and file three open milestone children: L8a Hardware-Adaptive Inference Runtime (three user-selected modes CPU & RAM only, GPU-Offload and GPU-Only; user-supplied, hash-pinned, copied Vulkan-first GPU components), L8b External Compatible-Model Registration & Qualification, and L9 Adaptive Time Budgets, Progress & ETA UX. Blocks edges: L8a after closed L1 (awkit-djnl.1) and closed L7 (awkit-djnl.10); L8b after L8a; L9 after L8a and L8b. Remove the epic-level edges awkit-akb -> awkit-djnl and awkit-vra -> awkit-djnl so Phases M and N stay independent (M1 and N1 keep their edge on closed L7). Refresh .beads/issues.jsonl with bd export -o. L0-L7 stay closed with their evidence. The plan documents, docs/ai narrative, src/roadmap/ImplementationRoadmap.ts and the verifier pins are ordinary unleased direct-loop edits made after this lease is released. No runtime, GPU, model-registration, Settings, timeout, progress or ETA behavior is implemented.

acceptance.description: The Phase L epic is open with exactly thirteen children: the ten original milestones still closed and three new open milestones L8a, L8b and L9, with blocks edges L8a after awkit-djnl.1 and awkit-djnl.10, L8b after L8a, L9 after L8a and L8b. The epic-level edges from awkit-akb and awkit-vra to awkit-djnl are gone, so M1 and N1 readiness is unchanged.
.beads/issues.jsonl is refreshed with bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl, and verify:roadmap-dashboard passes with Sources agree after its pins move to measured values.

evidence.command: bd show awkit-djnl and the output of each bd create and bd dep add
evidence.observed: bd update awkit-djnl --status open reopened the epic with a scope-expansion note. bd create --parent awkit-djnl returned awkit-djnl.11 (L8a), awkit-djnl.12 (L8b) and awkit-djnl.13 (L9). Each of the five bd dep add calls printed 'X depends on Y (blocks)': .11 on .1, .11 on .10, .12 on .11, .13 on .11, .13 on .12. The original ten children stay closed.

bd ready: 3 issues (the epic, L8a awkit-djnl.11, awkit-egkw). bd blocked: 19, including L8b and L9 on L8a as intended, but also the Phase M and N epics and every M and N child, because the reopened epic re-blocks awkit-akb and awkit-vra and bd propagates that through parent-child. Before the change bd ready listed 5 (both epics, M1, N1, awkit-egkw). The owner-decided removal of awkit-akb -> awkit-djnl and awkit-vra -> awkit-djnl is BLOCKED: the lease guard's project-state Beads grammar admits bd dep add but no bd dep remove. The two commands were handed to the owner, who chose to defer them.
Printed 'Exported 325 issues to .beads/issues.jsonl'. bd stats: Total 325, Open 22, In Progress 0, dependency-Blocked 19, Closed 301, Ready 3.

A measuring run before the pins moved failed exactly the three tracker pins (got 325 issues, 24 outstanding / 301 closed, 189 edges), 174/177. After the pins moved to those measured values, the final-state run printed 177/177 including '14 phases', 'no cycles in the real data', both narrative tallies agreeing at 65/2/0 and 'the Overview banner reads "Sources agree"'. npm run build PASS on the final state; git diff --check clean (line-ending notices only).

completion.blocked_on: PHL-EXT-BEADS's second half: removing the epic-level edges awkit-akb -> awkit-djnl and awkit-vra -> awkit-djnl needs bd dep remove, which the lease guard's Beads grammar does not admit. The owner deferred running 'bd dep remove awkit-akb awkit-djnl' and 'bd dep remove awkit-vra awkit-djnl' themselves. After they run: bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl and move the edge pin in scripts/verify-roadmap-dashboard.mjs by the measured change (expected 189 -> 187). Everything else in this contract is met.
completion.qa_basis: Tracker structure, ready set and export inspected with bd show, bd ready, bd blocked and bd stats; final state passed npm run build and verify:roadmap-dashboard 177/177 with Sources agree.
completion.qa_known_limitations: As in the 2026-09-19 registration, src/roadmap/ImplementationRoadmap.ts, scripts/verify-roadmap-dashboard.mjs and the docs/ai and docs/plans updates are ordinary unleased direct-loop edits made after the lease was released, so they sit outside this contract's project-state routing by design. The Program Status dashboard GUI was not opened; the verifier served the new snapshot. Until the owner removes the two epic edges, bd reports Phases M and N blocked while the dashboard (which treats epics as containers) shows M1 and N1 ready.

history.released_reason: L8a awkit-djnl.11, L8b awkit-djnl.12 and L9 awkit-djnl.13 filed under the reopened Phase L epic with five blocks edges, export refreshed to 325 issues. The M and N epic-edge removal is pending the owner because the guard grammar has no bd dep remove.
